title: Board Pitch
goal: Deliver a 5-minute product pitch presenting a new AI-powered analytics feature. Build 3–5 slides, present clearly, and handle 3 live Q&A questions from Mark and Tom.
context_doc:
PRODUCT: SmartInsights — AI Analytics Dashboard

Key Features:
- Real-time data visualization with AI summaries
- Predictive alerts: warns users before KPIs drop
- Natural language queries: ask your data in plain English
- Enterprise SSO + compliance (SOC2, GDPR)

Market data:
- 78% of enterprise clients say current reports take too long to generate
- Competitors: Tableau ($70/user/mo), Power BI ($10/user/mo)
- Our price point: $25/user/mo
- Projected ROI for clients: 3x within 6 months
- Beta results: 12 clients, avg 40% reduction in reporting time

Business case:
- Q1 target: 50 enterprise clients
- Revenue projection: $3M ARR by Q4
- Required investment: $800K (engineering + marketing)
hint: A great pitch has: 1) Hook (why this matters now), 2) The problem, 3) Your solution, 4) Evidence/data, 5) Ask (what you need). Prepare for tough questions about ROI and timeline!
opening_message: We're ready to hear your pitch. You have 5 minutes. Make it count.
